items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: In fact it was Chico Hamilton and Arnie Lawrence that convinced me.

ctx.x: Right. And it won’t be long I’m sure before I’m reading some CD of some new upcoming star and they’re going to mention Junior Mance as showing me this or that. I’m sure it will happen.
Yeah. But I really love teaching. You know I didn’t think I would like it as much as I did. In fact it was Chico Hamilton and Arnie Lawrence that convinced me. Chico is still there
teaching too, and he was there from the beginning. Arnie isn’t anymore. Arnie moved to Israel where he started a jazz school there.
